description: What a lender's published FreeRateUpdate page shows about the lender itself: the page URL, the Overview, Mortgage options and How it works sections as plain text, the loan types the page names, and who reviewed the biography and when. A name that matches more than one published page returns the matches and no profile rather than a guess, unless one display name matches the query exactly, which wins. A query of digits is read as a company NMLS. The company NMLS ID it returns is the lender's own ID as the lender supplied it, used to identify the lender and nothing more. NMLS-derived facts are not returned: licensed states, locations, and company details such as headquarters, formation date and trade names. No rate appears here and FRU never publishes which lender has the best rate. A refusal is named (no_match, ambiguous, no_profile), never an empty object.

q.description: Lender name, DBA alias, bank-name substring, or the company NMLS
